technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Design Java/Node.js contract API model to create thread-safe contract instances or context wrappers per transaction, ensuring transaction stub isolation without significant performance overhead.
U2/U3: Move proto helper functions from 'protos/utils' to a new standalone 'protoutils' package, updating all import references across the repository.
U4: Backport Kafka health check handlers and metrics from the master branch into the 1.4 LTS release branch, maintaining backward compatibility with 1.4 dependencies.
U5: Enhance the peer endorsement and ACL evaluation logic to permit channel Readers to execute read-only chaincode invocations (queries) that do not generate write sets.

U6: Introduce a dedicated configuration setting 'peer.discovery.externalEndpoint' to explicitly set the peer address advertised via Service Discovery independently of the internal gossip bind address.
U7: Register a REST '/version' endpoint on the operations service HTTP server for both peer and orderer binaries to expose version, commit hash, and build metadata.
U8: Audit and refactor Go chaincode samples to adhere strictly to idiomatic Go design patterns, error handling conventions, and clean code principles.
assumptions: The work will be executed by a single developer with experience in Go, Java, Docker, and Hyperledger Fabric architecture.
User stories U2 and U3 represent identical specifications for refactoring 'protos/utils' and will be handled as a single unified effort.
Existing CI/CD pipelines and integration test harnesses are available for local and automated testing.
Effort is estimated in standard 8-hour developer workdays.

activities.activity_description: Implement transactional context access for contract methods, including thread-safe instance-per-transaction lifecycle handling in Java/Node contract APIs and writing unit tests.
Extract protos/utils into the new protoutils package, update import references across core modules, clean up obsolete packages, and verify build scripts.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Health Check Backport to 1.4 LTS (U4)
activities.activity_description: Port Kafka health checker logic and endpoints from master to the v1.4 branch, adapt for dependency differences, and add regression tests.

activities.activity_name: Channel Reader Query ACL & Execution Support (U5)
activities.activity_description: Update access control policy enforcement on peer proposal handlers to allow Channel Readers to execute read-only chaincode proposals, preventing write-set modifications.
Add new peer configuration parameters for service discovery external endpoint override, update discovery service advertisement logic, and write tests.
Add the /version REST endpoint to the operations service package in both peer and orderer binaries, exposing version and build metadata.
Review and refactor Go chaincode samples to use idiomatic Go syntax, standard error checks, and modern packaging practices.
Execute end-to-end network tests, integration tests across peer/orderer services, and verify all updates against existing Fabric sample scenarios.
